mentions.name: GEGL/babl-based image editor for Mac
mentions.description: This is a raster, vector, and pixel image editor for Mac built on GEGL/babl, using Metal for on-canvas effect previews to achieve speed while maintaining full XCF compatibility.
mentions.source_excerpt: A GEGL/babl based image raster/vector/pixel editor for Mac. Using metal for all effect on-canvas previews to both have speed and full xcf compatibility.
